# A big meteor (two hits): a jittered icosahedron of radius 0.46 m centred on the origin (its pivot), mauve rock
# with a few glowing plum faces (hot spots). One bone each, tumbled by the game.
new
material new Rock --base-color 0.431 0.318 0.506 --no-slot
material new Hot --base-color 0.435 0.114 0.361 --emission 0.435 0.114 0.361 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name boulder --radius 0.46 --subdivisions 1 --location 0 0 0
material assign Rock
mode edit
select vert where "true"
randomize --amount 0.101 --seed 8
select face where "pos.x + pos.z > 0.414"
material assign Hot
mode object
shade flat
export boulder.glb
